annotations.title: Send a notice for a free eviction review

description: Send a landlord's draft eviction notice to Illinois attorney Justin Abdilla (Abdilla and Associates) for a free eviction review: he checks the notice before it is served, confirms the fee quote, and books a call. Fills the official form and the Affidavit of Service and emails them to the firm. IMPORTANT: only call this with the user's explicit consent to share their name, email and phone. Sending does not create an attorney-client relationship.
